description: The plot illustrates how loss ratio (in percent) varies with computational cost (TFLOPs) for five methods/configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs” and uses a logarithmic-style tick sequence with labeled values at approximately 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8 (range ~1e7 to ~9e8). The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)”, shown on a linear scale from about 94 to 100 with regularly spaced tick marks at 1% intervals. The Vanilla series is a purple solid line with triangle markers that stays flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. SepLLM (n=64) is an orange solid line with plus markers that rises from about 98.3% at 1e7 to around 100.0% by ~2e8–3e8, peaks near 100.4% at ~4e8, and then stays close to 100% through ~9e8. SepLLM (n=128) is a blue solid line with x markers that increases from about 97.0% at 1e7 to roughly 99.7–99.8% by ~2e8–3e8, reaches about 100.0% around ~4e8–5e8, and ends just under 100% (about 99.8–99.9%) near ~9e8. SepLLM (n=64, H) is a green solid line with diamond markers that climbs from about 97.5% at 1e7 to around 99.9–100.0% by ~2e8–5e8, shows a small high point near ~6e8 (about 100.2%), and finishes just below 100% around ~9e8. SepLLM (n=64, H/T) is a red solid line with circle markers that increases from about 94.0% at 1e7 to roughly 99.1% by ~4e8, drops to about 98.5% at ~5e8, returns to about 99.0% at ~6e8–7e8, and ends around 98.7% at ~9e8.
